{{Quote|This is the Bastion Second Fleet, under the command of Admiral Edouard Fenel, ready to take up position.|unidentified Bastion Second Fleet officer|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>}}
The '''Bastion Second Fleet''' was one of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] in [[137 ABY]]. Led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Edouard Fenel]], the fleet participated in the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]]. This fleet had a [[Color/Legends|red]] chevron on its [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], but it is unknown whether this could be a permanent fleet emblem or else could have been specifically applied to the fleet as a mark of recognition for the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]'s ships.
